prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1156; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change on the eastbound lanes. Insured reports the other vehicle drifted into their lane without signaling. Both drivers reported no visible damage beyond scuffing on the right rear quarter panel of the insured vehicle. Police report requested.

Entry 2: Police report received. Responding officer documented the other driver's lane change as the cause and cited the other driver. Photos of both vehicles reviewed and consistent with the insured's account. Liability appears clear, pending the other carrier's position.

Entry 3: Claimant has retained counsel. Representation letter received requesting all communications be directed to counsel. Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness with onset the day after the accident and is seeking medical evaluation. Whiplash injury noted in the file. Reserve adjusted to reflect bodily injury exposure.

Entry 4: Spoke with claimant's attorney's office regarding medical records and treatment history. Requested authorization for prior records covering the past five years for the cervical spine. Attorney indicated a demand package will follow once treatment concludes. Vehicle damage estimate received from repair facility and under review.

Entry 5: Reviewed medical documentation provided by counsel, including treatment notes describing whiplash symptoms and recommended physical therapy. Referred file to the bodily injury unit for evaluation of the demand. Continued monitoring of claimant's treatment progress. Property damage portion of the claim closed upon completion of repairs and payment to the repair facility.
